- Name: Cumulative Radio 365 (slug: radio-365)
- Version: 1.0.0 | Lineage: R2 | Stage: live

## What it is

24/7 indie radio station for independent artists: live Icecast stream (128kbps stereo), song titles, station site, and directory listings (TuneIn, Streamitter, radio-browser.info, Airable).

## Intended use

Indie artists and listeners: submit music, tune in, join launch alerts.

## Capabilities

- live Icecast 2.4.4 source (verified live 2026-10-01)
- directory listings across 5 directories
- launch-alert signup on station site
- server-side now-playing metadata

## Honest limitations

0/100 verified listener sessions (2026-10-01); site counters not yet verified with real users.
